description: This header file defines the interface for managing the status and configuration of network devices, including setting and getting harvesting status, reporting and polling periods, default values, validation, and utility functions for network device status management.

methods.name: SetNDSHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for network devices, accepting a boolean indicating enable/disable.

methods.name: GetNDSHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for network devices, returning true if enabled.

methods.name: SetNDSReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period (in seconds) for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDSReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period for network device scans.

methods.name: SetNDSPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period (in seconds) for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDSPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling period for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDSReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default reporting period.

methods.name: SetNDSReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period.

methods.name: GetNDSPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default polling period.

methods.name: SetNDSPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period.

methods.name: GetNDSOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default timeout value for accelerated scans.

methods.name: ValidateNDSPeriod
methods.description: Validates that a given period value falls within the acceptable range.

methods.name: SetNDSOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the override TTL (timeout) for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDSOverrideTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the current override TTL value.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeString
methods.description: Returns the current time as a string.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeInSecond
methods.description: Returns the current time in seconds.

methods.name: isvalueinarray
methods.description: Checks if a given value exists within an array.

methods.name: ResetNDSReportingConfiguration
methods.description: Resets the network device scanning and reporting configuration to defaults.

methods.name: print_list
methods.description: Prints the network device status list.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes the network device status list.
